Summary
Last episode, "Burning the Linked Camps," tells of Lu Xun's use of fire attacks to defeat the Shu army, and Liu Bei's critical illness in Bai Di City, where he entrusted his son to Zhuge Liang.
This episode narrates how Cao Pi ordered Grand Commander Cao Zhen to attack Shu, forming alliances with Liaodong and the Southern Barbarians, launching a five-pronged invasion. Kong Ming remained calm in his chancellor's office, commanding the defense at various passes and repelling four enemy forces; he also sent Deng Zhi as an envoy to Eastern Wu to persuade Sun Quan. Wu and Shu restored their old alliance to jointly resist Cao Wei. Upon hearing the news, Cao Pi launched an attack on Wu, but was defeated by Wu general Xu Sheng using fire attacks.
Next episode, "Zhuge Liang Crosses the Lu River," tells of Kong Ming using psychological warfare, capturing and releasing the Southern King Meng Huo seven times, ultimately subduing him.

Liu Bei has just died, and Liu Chan is incompetent. I wish to take this opportunity to launch an attack on Shu. What do you all think?

1. After Emperor Liu Bei's death, his son Liu Chan, weak and incompetent, became emperor, but all military and state affairs were decided by Kong Ming. Emperor Cao Pi, upon hearing the news, saw an opportunity and summoned his civil and military officials to discuss the matter.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《安居平五路》的第2页，包含内容提要和第一幅插图。提要回顾了上集“火烧连营”，概述了本集曹丕五路伐蜀、诸葛亮安居平五路、吴蜀重修旧好等情节，并预告下集“诸葛亮渡泸水”。插图描绘了曹丕召集文武大臣商议伐蜀，对话框中曹丕提出趁刘备新亡、刘禅无能之机起兵伐蜀。

2. The Grand Tutor Jia Xu believed it was unwise. He said that when Liu Bei died, he entrusted his son to Kong Ming. Kong Ming was always cautious and careful, and the borders had already been prepared. A sudden advance would not guarantee victory.

3. Suddenly, someone stood up resolutely from the assembly. When everyone looked, it was Sima Yi. He glanced at Jia Xu and loudly said, "If we don't advance now, when shall we?" Cao Pi was delighted and hurriedly asked Sima Yi for his brilliant strategy.
If we only raise troops from the Central Plains, it will be of no use. We must use five armies from different directions to attack simultaneously, forcing Kong Ming to be unable to defend both front and rear...

page_text_en:
8. Sun Quan immediately summoned Lu Xun. Lu Xun said, "If we do not comply with Cao Pi, we will surely make enemies. I estimate that neither Wei nor Wu can match Kong Ming. Your Majesty may pretend to agree and make preparations in advance. If Wei's army wins, we will then advance directly to capture Chengdu; if Cao Pi's army loses, we will reconsider." 
9. Sun Quan followed the plan, sent the Wei envoy back, and only said they agreed to join forces to attack Shu, waiting until military supplies were prepared before choosing a day to advance.
summary_zh: 孙权召见陆逊商议是否响应曹丕联合伐蜀的提议，陆逊建议佯装同意并暗中准备，待魏军胜败再决定行动；孙权采纳此计，向魏使表示同意联合攻蜀，待军需筹备完毕再出兵。

10. The news of Wei's five-pronged invasion of Shu soon reached Chengdu. Liu Chan, who had never experienced such a crisis before, was shocked and panicked, and immediately sent an eunuch to summon Kong Ming to court.

page_text_en:
12. Dong and Du arrived at the Chancellor's residence, but the gatekeepers would not let them in. Du Qiong became anxious and said, 'The Wei army is invading from five directions; the military situation is urgent. The Chancellor bears great responsibility—how can he pretend to be ill and stay away?' The gatekeeper, unable to resist, had to go inside to inform Kong Ming.
13. Shortly after, the gatekeeper came out to deliver a message: 'The Chancellor's condition has slightly improved; he will attend court tomorrow to discuss affairs.' Dong Yun and Du Qiong, unable to see Kong Ming, returned home dejectedly.
summary_zh: 董允和杜琼奉命前往丞相府通报紧急军情，但被门吏拦住，杜琼急切要求入内告知诸葛亮，门吏无奈只得通报。不久后，门吏回话称诸葛亮病体稍好，明日上朝，二人未能见到诸葛亮，只得失望返回。

15. 刘禅没了主意，启奏太后。太后大惊，便要亲往丞相府见孔明。董允奏道：“丞相托病，必有用意，且待皇上先去，如果不见，娘娘再去不迟。”

page_text_en:
14. The next day, all the officials came to the Chancellor's residence to await him. They waited from morning until evening, but saw no sign of Kongming, and were not allowed to enter. Everyone was confused and anxious, and had no choice but to disperse.
15. Liu Chan, having no idea what to do, reported to the Empress Dowager. The Empress Dowager was greatly alarmed and decided to go personally to the Chancellor's residence to see Kongming. Dong Yun advised, "The Chancellor is pretending to be ill; there must be a reason. Let the Emperor go first. If he does not see him, then Your Majesty may go later." 
How did the late Emperor entrust his orphaned son to the Chancellor at his deathbed? Now that the nation is in peril, yet he refuses to come out on the grounds of illness—what does this mean?

The barbarian troops are suspicious; I have ordered Wei Yan to lead an army, moving left then right, right then left, as a feint, so Meng Huo will surely dare not advance..."
21. Kong Ming continued: "Yangping Pass is the gateway to Western Shu, and its terrain is steep and defensible. I have dispatched Zhao Yun to lead an army to guard the pass. 23. 刘禅想不到自己睡在梦里，孔明已拒敌于千里之外，顿时满怀忧虑，一扫而空。他怕太后在宫里焦急，便辞了孔明，启驾回宫。

22. Liu Shan was overjoyed. Kong Ming added, "The enemy came in five routes, but four have already retreated. There's no need to worry. Eastern Wu is merely observing and won't advance immediately. Nevertheless, we must choose a persuasive person to convince Sun Quan using arguments of self-interest. I was just watching fish by the pond, contemplating this very choice."
23. Liu Shan realized he had been asleep in a dream, while Kong Ming had already repelled the enemy from thousands of miles away. His worries vanished instantly. Worried that the Empress Dowager might be anxious in the palace, he bid farewell to Kong Ming and returned to the palace.

89. 东吴大破魏兵，孙权论功行赏：徐盛策划调度，自是首功，丁奉奋勇杀敌，也得了重赏。只有孙韶虽然立功，却因不听将令，受了一顿训诫。欲知后事，请看下集《诸葛亮渡泸水》
page_text_en:
88. Sun Shao and Ding Feng chased and killed, seizing countless horses, carriages, ships, and weapons. The Wei army was defeated and retreated. Zhang Liao returned to Xuchang, where his arrow wound burst open and he died.
89. Eastern Wu defeated the Wei army. Sun Quan awarded merits: Xu Sheng, for his planning and coordination, received the top credit; Ding Feng, for his brave fighting, also received a heavy reward. Only Sun Shao, although he achieved merit, was reprimanded for disobeying orders. To know what happens next, please read the next volume, 'Zhuge Liang Crosses the Lu River'.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴大破魏军后的两个场景：一是孙韶、丁奉追击魏军，张辽因箭伤复发而死；二是孙权论功行赏，徐盛、丁奉受赏，孙韶因违令被训诫，并预告下集《诸葛亮渡泸水》。
